Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Liberia's NIR has bilateral MoUs with the Civil Service Agency for payroll verification using National Identification Numbers (NINs), and with the Liberia Telecommunications Authority for SIM registration. A World Bank GREAT project is underway to expand the National Biometric Identification System. Full integration with a data exchange layer is planned but not operational.

Comments: The Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) has been digitalized and the National Electronic Payment Switch (NEPS) exists, regulated by the Central Bank of Liberia under the Payment System Act. Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Liberia has the Electronics Transaction Law (2002), NIR Act (2011), ICT Policy 2019-2024, and CBL E-Payment Regulations (2020) providing partial legal basis for digital services. No standalone data protection law or cross-government data sharing legislation exists. A data protection bill has been referenced as pending.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: The NIR 5-Year Strategic Plan (2026-2030) includes digital ID modernization and interoperable platforms as a pillar. The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications Strategic Plan (2025-2029) provides a 4-pillar framework but lacks a detailed data exchange implementation roadmap with specific milestones.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Liberia launched its 5-year 'Digital Liberia: Equity, Sovereignty and Innovation for a Connected Future' strategy (2025-2029) which includes e-governance and data sovereignty as priority areas. The strategy mentions interoperability and DPI but does not provide a dedicated data exchange strategy document. Data exchange is referenced within the broader digital transformation context.
